title: Read TestFlight feedback from App Store Connect into the playtest triage inbox
body:
Follow-up to epic #9888 (#9884; docs/game/playtesting.md open question 3). TestFlight's own feedback (screenshot feedback and crash feedback from **Send Beta Feedback**) reaches App Store Connect with the build, device, and OS, and nothing in this repository reads it.

Scope: `openagents playtest inbox` (or a sibling `openagents playtest testflight`) reads the App Store Connect API's beta feedback submissions for the OpenAgents app (app ID 6748620735) with an ASC API key (issuer, key ID, `.p8`, read from an env file, never printed), and drafts them like private reports: a code, a draft issue, and a `received` triage-log entry, deduplicated by the submission ID. TestFlight testers have no Nostr key, so a TestFlight entry can't back a playtest award by itself; the log says so.

Acceptance: JWT signing (ES256) and response parsing are unit tested against fixtures; a live read against App Store Connect works with the owner's key; drafts land in the same drafts directory and log; docs/game/playtest-triage.md updated.
